headline: Restructuring 'EV' tax, maintaining car production base; 'EV Board' focuses on domestic production; 'CBU' faces highest rate
summary: Thailand's EV Board approved restructuring the EV excise tax based on investment, production and local parts use. CBU imports face the highest rates as BEV imports surged 72%.
why: Excise tax structures determine the relative cost of imported and locally produced vehicles, shaping investment decisions by global automakers in Thailand.
